brief: Design an interface for a "Temporal Recipe Transmutation Chamber" where users manipulate the lifecycle of ingredients through time to discover new dishes - imagine a circular vessel interface where ingredients are represented as crystalline forms that age, ferment, caramelize, or decompose based on temporal manipulation rings that users rotate around the chamber, with each temporal state revealing different chemical reactions visualized as flowing particle connections between ingredients, requir
critique: The interface suffers from a complete lack of visual hierarchy with no accompanying CSS, resulting in raw HTML elements that clash with the conceptual complexity. The innovative temporal cooking mechanic is buried under poor execution, creating a jarring disconnect between the sophisticated interaction model and the unpolished visual presentation.
fixes: Implement a clear visual hierarchy with 2-3 font sizes max and use CSS-in-JS or CSS modules instead of inline styles
Replace the murky color palette with high-contrast, accessible colors that clearly differentiate temporal states
Simplify to a single ring control and remove particle effects until core interactions are polished
